This '''individual''' was a member of the [[Revwien/Legends|Revwien]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It had a green body and a yellow [[Seed/Legends|seed]] case. It was present on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] outside [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]].
